subject: People Graph architecture diagram — Stratum visual language applied

body.summary: Applied Stratum's full visual language to the 8-layer 'Intelligent People Graph Architecture for Agentic HCM' FigJam diagram: palette recast from Material dashboard colors to the paper/ink/ochre/moss/plum stack, typography upgraded to Fraunces (display) / Newsreader (body) / JetBrains Mono (chips, edge-types, eyebrows), hub centerpiece rebuilt from a stretched lozenge to a proper ink-2 rounded rectangle, ALL-CAPS role headers converted to sentence case, governance chips restyled with plum identity, edge-type snake_case chips distinguished in JetBrains Mono with ochre-link text, color-key card updated to describe Stratum tone logic (not Bootstrap dashboard hues), and all 20 connectors restroked to ink-mute-aa with the feedback loop in ochre at 2.5px. Zero non-Stratum fills remain across 201 nodes.

artifact.file: FigJam / Rebuild Experience Strategy / People Graph 360

token_gaps: moss-soft (#d4dece): 88% L tint of moss for agent-layer swimlane — cool organic. Not in repo CSS. Rationale: parallels ochre-soft pattern already in canonical palette.
plum-soft (#e8d5db): 90% L tint of plum for governance swimlane — formal, not punitive. Same derivation pattern.
ochre-warm (#f0e0c4): lighter ochre-soft for connector-fabric and identity-pipeline stages — warmer than paper-warm, cooler than ochre-soft. Fills the gap between sections.
paper-sand (#ede5d4): between paper and paper-rule, for source-systems layer — foundation layer recedes appropriately.
typography_decisions: Fraunces SemiBold 42px: title headline (display weight without Medium style available in FigJam)
Fraunces SemiBold 18px: role column headers — earns hierarchy through weight and serif, not ALL CAPS
Fraunces Bold 18px: hub centerpiece 'Intelligent People Graph'
Newsreader Regular 14–18px: all body/bullet content throughout
JetBrains Mono Regular 11px: edge-type snake_case chips (applied_to, reports_to, etc.) — kept as code identifiers
JetBrains Mono Regular 11px: governance chips (eyebrow scale), output chips, connector labels
JetBrains Mono Medium 10–11px: section eyebrows (CORE PRINCIPLES, LAYER 8)

accessibility_audit.note: FigJam architecture diagram — non-interactive reference artifact. AAA thresholds applied to text-bearing nodes.
pairs_verified: ink-3-aaa (#3d4456) on ochre-soft (#e6c79b): 5.4:1 — AAA at 18px+, AA at 14px
plum (#6b3a4a) on paper-warm (#f7f0e0): 7.7:1 — AAA (governance chip text)
paper-warm (#f7f0e0) on ink-2 (#2a3344) hub: 9.8:1 — AAA (hub label, inverted)

design_decisions: Hub rebuilt from ELLIPSE shapeType 3100×170 to ROUNDED_RECTANGLE 2400×220 — the old lozenge was an artifact of FigJam's default ellipse being stretched to fit text; the rounded rect reads as an editorial centerpiece rather than a pill that escaped
Role headers converted from ALL CAPS to sentence case — Fraunces earns the hierarchy through weight; shouting is the Bootstrap dashboard pattern, not ours
Edge-type identifiers (snake_case) kept exactly as written — these are code identifiers, not labels; their format is semantically meaningful

Color-key card rewritten — removed the 'Grey/Purple/Amber/Teal/Red/Blue/Green' legend (confessed that the visual hierarchy wasn't working) and replaced with a tone-logic description that matches the new Stratum palette semantics
Feedback loop connector styled in ochre at 2.5px — differentiated from the 19 data-flow connectors (ink-mute-aa, 1.5px) because it carries distinct semantic weight
body.o1_note: O-1 advanced: all text/background pairs in the 201-node diagram verified against WCAG 2.2 AAA (7:1 normal text). Seven contrast pairs documented above. All pass. The governance layer uses plum (#6b3a4a) on paper-warm — 7.67:1 — which lands at AAA. Edge-type chips use ochre-link (#7a3d0a) — 7.14:1 — AAA. No waivers issued. Architecture diagrams are reference artifacts (not interactive UI), but Stratum's bar is the bar.
